title: PolyBlock Racing
tagline: A blockchain based low poly racing game using Unity engine and Moralis SDK
description: This project is a low poly metaverse racing game built with Unity. The players can login using WalletConnect and use their NFT car to race in the game. This project is not completed yet. In the future, it is planned to add NFT assets and AI opponents to the game.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         .                                                                                                                                                                                             .                                                                                                                                                                                         .
how_its_made: This project is built with Unity and C#. Moralis SDK is used for blockchiain integration(login with WalletConnect at the moment). This project is not completed yet. In the future it is planned to add NFT assets and AI opponents to the project.                                                                                                                                                       .                                                                                                                                                                                             .                                                                                                                                                                                         .
